title: Technical English — Course 4, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 9

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the documentation class take place?
tasks.audioText: The power supply documentation class will take place on Thursday at twelve fifteen in the electronics room. Students should bring a copy of the sample specification sheet. The instructor will identify the input range, output rating and connector information. The class will compare two documents and discuss why the model reference must be checked before information is used.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What specification document is needed for the power-supply lesson?
tasks.audioText: The power supply documentation class will take place on Thursday at twelve fifteen in the electronics room. Students should bring a copy of the sample specification sheet. The instructor will identify the input range, output rating and connector information. The class will compare two documents and discuss why the model reference must be checked before information is used.

tasks.prompt: A power supply specification sheet lists important information about the device, including input conditions, output ratings and connector details. A student compared two similar models and noticed that their output ratings were different. The student checked the full model references before recording the information. This prevented the specifications from being mixed between the two devices. Reading 1. Which details may be listed on a power supply specification sheet?
options: Supplier address, delivery date and purchase order
Equipment colour, storage location and serial-number format
Input conditions, output ratings and connector details
Operator name, shift time and maintenance history

tasks.prompt: Why did the student check the full model references?
options: To confirm the purchase price of each device
To replace the need to check connector details
To identify which device was delivered first
To avoid mixing specifications from two similar models

tasks.prompt: The output ratings ___ on the specification sheet.
Choose TWO electrical performance details normally stated on a power supply specification sheet.
A document that lists the technical characteristics of a product is a specification ___.
Two similar power supplies have different ratings. What should you do?
options: Use the same data for both models.
Check the full model references before recording the specifications.
Choose the higher rating for both.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of power supply documentation in a logical order.
options: Check output ratings and connector details
Record the specifications with the model reference
correctOrder: Check output ratings and connector details
Record the specifications with the model reference

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining why a power supply specification sheet should be checked before information is recorded or compared.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains why the relevant power-supply specification sheet should be checked (0–2); it identifies relevant specification details such as ratings, units, limits or revision before recording/comparing information (0–2); the explanation is clearly organised with understandable grammar (0–2); specification/electrical vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
